svg.title: Kinematic fidelity aggregation
svg.desc: Each matched joint quality is the product of motion, unwrapped extent and limit pattern agreement. Moving-joint and fixed-constraint recovery each use twice the summed joint quality divided by the combined reference and candidate count. Kinematic fidelity is the geometric mean of active recovery groups, expressed as a percentage.

g.text: Missing or invalid matches earn zero.
Omit empty groups. One active group:
Unmeasured reference semantics: score unmeasured, with bounds.
